summary: This note is a short encyclopedic entry on Leïla Ben Ali, born Trabelssi on 24 October 1956. It identifies her as the wife of Zine El Abidine Ben Ali, who served as President of Tunisia from 1987 to 2011, and states that they married in 1992.
one_line: Leïla Ben Ali (born 1956) is the wife of former Tunisian president Zine El Abidine Ben Ali.
key_facts: Leïla Ben Ali was born née Trabelssi on 24 October 1956.
Leïla Ben Ali is the wife of Zine El Abidine Ben Ali.
Zine El Abidine Ben Ali was President of Tunisia from 1987 to 2011.
Leïla Ben Ali married Zine El Abidine Ben Ali in 1992.
